title: The Extreme Significance of Bilateral Embolic Retinal Phenomena That Can be Life Saving
brief_summary: This study shows how careful ophthalmic examination of two patients showed signs of simultaneous bilateral retinal emboli. Starting from this point significant, life threatening, underlying reasons were found and treated.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* any patient who is found to have sure signs of bilateral retinal emboli.

Exclusion Criteria:

* all other bilateral retinal diseases.
study_population: any patient in which signs of bilateral retinal emboli are seen and documented (imaged).
